blurb: PanIQ Room Long Beach offers fully immersive escape rooms where players solve puzzles and find clues to escape within a set time. Themes include pirates, ghosts, wizards, and more. They also offer a VR Escape Experience with various virtual reality adventures for 1-5 players.
extraNote: All games are private · Groups usually arrive 15 minutes prior and stay 10 minutes after game · 327 Pine Ave, Downtown Long Beach, CA 90802
